page.title: Divetrope: endless-zoom stories for the web
page.description: An open-source web component for endless-zoom stories. Each scene hides the next one in its centre.

intro.title: Scroll into the picture.
intro.sub: An open-source web component for endless-zoom stories.
intro.alt: or scroll at your own pace

layers.label: Earth
layers.alt: Earth from space, half in daylight and half at night, its cities lit
layers.headline: Scroll into the picture.
layers.body: Each scene hides the next one in its centre. Keep going, and the last one hides the first.

layers.label: Continent
layers.alt: A continent seen from orbit as night falls across it
layers.headline: A web component, no dependencies.
layers.body: Add one script tag and a manifest. No framework and no build step on your site.

layers.label: Nightfall
layers.alt: Green hills at nightfall, with lights gathering into a town
layers.headline: A page, a section, or a player.
layers.body: Take over the whole page, pin as a section while readers scroll, or sit in a window with its own Play button.

layers.label: The city
layers.alt: A city at night from above, its streets glowing gold
layers.headline: Play it like one long take.
layers.body: Play runs the story with an adaptive score. Scroll, drag or tap the dots to take the wheel.

layers.label: Downtown
layers.alt: An old town at night from above, with a square block at its centre

layers.label: Rooftops
layers.alt: A tiled roof from above, with a glass skylight in the middle

layers.label: Skylight
layers.alt: Looking down through the skylight into a warm, candlelit bar
layers.headline: Copy, colours and fonts in one file.
layers.body: Headlines, chips, theme, logo and the closing call to action all live in dive.json.

layers.label: The couple
layers.alt: A couple at a small round table, smiling at each other by candlelight

layers.label: Her glass
layers.alt: A glass of champagne on the wooden table between them
layers.headline: Bring layers from any source.
layers.body: Use an image model, a camera or a paintbrush. The build crops, feathers and sizes every layer.

layers.label: Champagne
layers.alt: Looking straight down into the champagne, full of rising bubbles

layers.label: Bubbles
layers.alt: Bubbles in the champagne, one of them holding a galaxy
layers.headline: MIT licensed.
layers.body: Use it in client work, fork it, ship it.

layers.label: The bubble
layers.alt: A spiral galaxy inside a single bubble

layers.label: Galaxy arm
layers.alt: The heart of a galaxy, with a tiny Earth in its dark centre
layers.headline: Two example dives ship with it.
layers.body: This loop, and a one-minute product commercial that ends on a call to action.

layers.label: Home
layers.alt: Earth, small and alone in a dark opening among the stars
